description: A prompt's `schema:` that isn't itself a well-formed JSON Schema at all (`type: 5`, not one of the metaschema's own recognized values) is refused at compile time, before any model request, naming the effect -- not only the `multipleOf`/`$ref`-chain corners this step adds, but any other way `check_schema` rejects it too.
location_pattern: Prompt 'ask': schema is not a valid JSON Schema
